{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yin Wood Rabbit''' (乙卯, ''kinoto usagi''; onyomi ''otsubō'') is the 52nd of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 52nd of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Wood Tiger|ja|甲寅}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Fire Dragon|ja|丙辰}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''乙'' is Yin Wood, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''卯'' (Rabbit) is Yin Wood; together they form a Biwa (Mutual Harmony) relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Wood Rabbit (乙卯)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): yǐmǎo
** Cantonese (Jyutping): jyut3 maau5
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kinoto-usagi
*** On'yomi: otsubō
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): eulmyo (을묘)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Ất Mão

==Months of Yin Wood Rabbit==
In years where the last digit is 3 or 8 (corresponding to the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} {{ill|Mizunoto (癸)|ja|癸|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui}} or {{ill|Tsuchinoe (戊)|ja|戊|lt=Tsuchinoe (戊)|2=ja|3=戊|4=zh|5=戊|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu}}), the {{ill|February|en|February|qid=Q109|lt=February}} of that year is considered a Yin Wood Rabbit month. However, this applies to the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar calendar}}, and in some cases, the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Jingzhe|en|Jingzhe|qid=Q1306596|lt=Jingzhe}} to the day before {{ill|Qingming (solar term)|en|Qingming (solar term)|qid=Q1680269|lt=Qingming}}) is used.

==Days of Yin Wood Rabbit==
=== Selection Days ===
Yin Wood Rabbit days are the third day of the {{ill|Hassen|ja|八専|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hassen}} cycle, excluding intervening days.
